summary: Alert notifications drop trace links when alert query is rewritten by optimizer
description:
Issue summary:
Customers with dashboard alerts that rely on trace links (`trace_link` / `trace_id`) are receiving notifications with the trace link omitted when the alert evaluator rewrites their ad-hoc query during evaluation. The alert fires correctly (count/threshold is correct) but the notification card and the alert email contain no link back to the trace, preventing customers from drilling into traces from the alert.
steps_to_reproduce:
1) Customer creates a dashboard widget that includes tracing hooks (trace_link reference) and saves an ad-hoc query.
2) Create an alert on that widget using a custom query that references an expression or alias (example uses a subquery/alias for grouping).
3) Wait for the alert to fire or force-evaluate it.
4) Observe the alert notification in Console and email: notifications do not include the 'View Trace' link or trace_id context.
5) In some cases, adding an explicit 'SELECT trace_link' to the saved query restores the link (workaround).
impact: Customer (BrightCart, enterprise) - inability to quickly triage alerting incidents because alert notifications lack trace links. Leads to increased mean time to investigate (MTTI) and escalations to Support. Affects multiple customers running ad-hoc queries with aliases or optimizer-friendly patterns.
logs_and_evidence:
- Eval logs (query-engine): optimizer rewrite shows projection elimination: `SELECT ...` -> `SELECT ...` (trace_link removed) (see partial extract below).
- Application log excerpt (us-east alert-eval pool) 2026-03-09T21:42:11Z: evaluator=alerts id=246381-start rewrite=true removed_cols=[trace_link]
- Slack thread: https://slack.redwood.ai/archives/C0123ABC45/p1678470000000
- Customer-provided screenshot of alert email (redacted) attached in case file (internal link).
comments: 2026-03-09 - Aisha Patel (Support): Customer BrightCart reported that alert emails are missing 'View Trace' links; they can only see timestamp and error count. Raised to SRE for triage.

2026-03-09 - Diego Martinez (SRE): Reproduced in staging with a simplified query. When query-engine rewrites the expression, trace_link column is pruned from final projection. Opening issue with query-engine team. Assigned to query-engine on-call.
2026-03-10 - Priya Rao (Query-engine): Linked PR #4582 looked suspicious; it introduced more aggressive projection elimination for optimizer. Adding instrumentation to confirm column-level reasoning.
investigation_notes: Initial hypothesis: optimizer rewrite/projection elimination removes columns that are not referenced in the final aggregation expression. However, trace_link is expected to be a side-channel used by Console/alerting for drilldown. Recent change (PR #4582 merged 2026-02-28) made projection elimination too aggressive and did not consider side-channel consumers (alerts/console). Repro case: saved query uses 'group by user_alias' and alert performs post-eval enrichment for trace_link; optimizer removes trace_link because it thinks it's unused in numeric aggregation. Verified by instrumenting the rewrite path and reproducing in staging. Query-engine logs show 'removed_cols=[trace_link]'.
resolution_notes:
Temporary workaround provided to customer: add an explicit 'SELECT trace_link' in the alert query or enable 'disable_query_rewrite=true' in alert advanced settings.
Engineer fix: query-engine PR #4620 adds a preservation rule to keep 'trace_link' and any column tagged as 'console_side_channel' during rewrite when the query is being evaluated for alerts. Patch deployed to staging on 2026-03-11. Canary rollout planned for prod on 2026-03-15 with monitoring on alert-eval success and notification completeness.
Follow-ups: add regression test covering alert-driven query evaluation, update developer docs to document 'console_side_channel' tagging for future columns, update Confluence runbook 'alert-eval-query-rewrite' with workaround steps and timeline. Notify BrightCart CSM when prod canary completes.
next_steps: 1) Complete canary rollout 2026-03-15 and validate notifications contain trace links. 2) Add automated regression to CI to ensure future optimizer changes don't drop side-channel columns. 3) Update Console alert UI to surface a 'preserve trace links' toggle for customers. 4) Close ticket after customer confirmation and postmortem entry.
